BASIS: 1,000 kg FINISHED cSPG (24,300 kg ROM ORE)

g.text: 5. PURIFIED SLURRY TO COUNTER-CURRENT FILTER PRESS & LIME NEUTRALIZATION
• Purified Graphite Filter Cake: 1,010 kg (>= 99.95% C | Stage Mass Yield: 88.5%)
• Counter-Current Deionized Wash Water: 15 - 25 m3/t | Slaked Lime: 400 kg CaO (~$60/t)
• Precipitated Sludge: ~650 kg CaF2 / CaCl2 / SiF4 cake (Waste disposal ~$320/t | Stage 3A: +$1,100/t)
• Stage 3A Electricity: 0.276 kWh/kg | Total Natural cSPG Chemical Route Power: 7.91 kWh/kg
• Environmental Regulatory Audit: Zero toxic fluoride discharge via complete CaF2 precipitation.
• Quality Lot Spec: Trace Fe < 20 ppm, Ash <= 0.05% for battery cell safety qualification.
CHEMICAL INSET: PORE-DIFFUSION LEACHING, STOICHIOMETRY & THERMAL TRADE-OFF
A. INTRA-PARTICLE PORE DIFFUSION IN CABBAGE-FOLDED uSPG (D50 = 15.0 um)
Why Mechanical Flotation Stops at 94-97% C:
• Residual 3-5% ash (SiO2, Fe2O3, Al2O3) is crystallographically locked
between graphene lamellae and folded inside uSPG micro-cavities.
Why HF Acid Is Required in Route 3A:
• HCl and HNO3 dissolve metallic oxides (Fe, Al, Ca) but CANNOT break
the strong covalent Si-O bond (452 kJ/mol) of quartz (SiO2).
• Only HF forms stable hexafluorosilicate [SiF6]2- complexes at 60-90 °C,
leaving clean internal pores ready for Stage 4 pitch sealing.
• Battery Spec: Fe < 20 ppm (prevents internal lithium-dendrite shorting).
B. STOICHIOMETRIC DIGESTION & EFFLUENT NEUTRALIZATION REACTIONS
1. QUARTZ & ALUMINOSILICATE DISSOLUTION (180 kg HF / t cSPG):
SiO2(s) + 4 HF(aq) ---> SiF4(g)^ + 2 H2O(l) [Gas to Wet Scrubber]
2. TRANSITION METAL OXIDE & SULFIDE LEACHING (200 kg HCl + 100 kg HNO3 / t cSPG):
Fe2O3(s) + 6 HCl(aq) ---> 2 FeCl3(aq) + 3 H2O(l) [Soluble Ferric Chloride]
Al2O3(s) + 6 HCl(aq) ---> 2 AlCl3(aq) + 3 H2O(l) [HNO3 oxidizes FeS2 pyrite]
3. WASTEWATER LIME NEUTRALIZATION & SLUDGE PRECIPITATION (400 kg CaO / t cSPG):
2 HF(aq) + Ca(OH)2(aq) ---> CaF2(s)v + 2 H2O(l) [Insoluble Fluorspar Cake]
C. PURIFICATION PATHWAY BENCHMARK: CHEMICAL HF (3A) VS. THERMAL 2,800 °C (3B)
